Ordinary member text containing any configured keyword gets a saved reply; no separate master switch.

• 1–8 keywords per rule, each 2–50 characters, using contains matching. Does not inherit moderation pinyin/homophone/exact-message modes.
• Saved text, photo, video, animation or document replies with up to 3 HTTPS buttons; no generated content.
• 60-second cooldown per member/rule; at most {reply_group_limit} replies per group over 60 seconds. Excess triggers skipped, not queued; at most one reply per message.

help,tutorial can match where is the tutorial? The same member's repeat after 30 seconds is skipped. Admins, captions and /commands do not trigger ordinary replies; intercepted messages do not continue to replies.

📖 Scheduled announcements · Feature guide

Once: a future date/time, up to one year ahead. Daily: a time such as 09:00. Weekly: a weekday/time such as Monday 19:30.

Pause preserves configuration; resume recomputes the next future run. Delete stops future sends without withdrawing previous posts.

Uses the displayed bot timezone, Beijing time by default; up to 20 tasks per group. Daily 09:00 created today at 10:00 starts tomorrow.

Independent of welcome/smart anti-spam/content observation. Sends over 6 hours late after downtime are skipped. Tasks pause when their creator is confirmed to have lost admin status. Delays/rare duplicates remain possible; custom text is not translated.

📖 Today and last 7 days · Feature guide

Shows recorded messages, deletions, joins and penalties for this group. Seven days includes today; groups are separate.

Starts with events actually received, not pre-installation history. Counts differ from accepted-text activity and are not unique visitors or live online members. Individual deletions and accepted bulk-clean requests are separate; bulk success does not confirm every ID was deleted.

Read-only; does not require smart anti-spam. Use protection records for reasons/failures and the points leaderboard for points rankings.
📖 活跃排行 · 功能说明\n\n按最近7天记录的未被拦截文字或媒体说明消息数排:
📖 Activity leaderboard · Feature guide

Ranks accepted text/caption messages over 7 days. Stores dates, user IDs and counts, not message bodies.

Commands, bot messages and other excluded events do not count as ordinary text activity. Not points, unique people or pre-installation history. Groups are separate; detail retained for up to 30 days.

Reading does not enable points or reward messages. Identify numeric IDs using group member identity.
📖 规则总览 · 功能说明\n\n查看当前群已保存的开关和参数，适合更新后检查沿:
📖 Rule overview · Feature guide

Reads this group's saved switches/parameters, useful after updates; does not enable a recommended preset.

Smart anti-spam is not a master switch for everything. Keywords, flooding, cross-account repeats, photos, OCR and join verification have separate conditions.

Enabled switches may still be observed, lack permissions or have no base words. Check the overview, adjust the corresponding page and inspect protection records for outcomes. Groups do not automatically sync settings.
📖 防护记录 · 功能说明\n\n核对命中原因、消息/成员ID、词条、分类、识别:
📖 Protection records · Feature guide

Shows reasons, message/member IDs, words, packs, match types and outcomes:
• Observed: no deletion/penalty for that rule.
• Deleted: individual deletion API succeeded.
• Bulk clean submitted: accepted request, not per-message confirmation.
• Failed: check permissions, network and target; penalties recorded separately.
• Reviewed: admin marker only, without restoration, undoing punishment or rule changes.

30-day retention, up to 1000 records/group; metadata only, no original text/photos. Cannot restore deleted content. Adjust exceptions, allowlists or thresholds separately after false positives.
📖 管理日志 · 功能说明\n\n将管理事件、部分自动处理及OCR审核信息发到独:
📖 Moderation log destination · Feature guide

Sends moderation events, some automatic actions and OCR reviews to a separate admin log group/channel.

Add the bot with permissions; you must administer the destination too. Obtain its negative chat ID and configure from the original group. The original group cannot log to itself.

0 or /setlog off disables sending, not local protection records or group protection. Delivery depends on mode, permissions and network. Separate from public documentation/web dashboard.
📖 权限检查 · 功能说明\n\n查看群类型、机器人管理身份、删除消息与限制成员:
📖 Permission check · Feature guide

Reads group type, bot admin status, delete/restrict permissions and OCR engine status. Does not grant permissions.

Ad deletion needs delete permission. Mute, verification and raid protection need a supergroup and corresponding restrictions/permissions. Welcome, replies and announcements need text/media sending permissions.

Grant missing permissions in Telegram, then recheck. Query failure does not prove authorization; switches alone do not guarantee execution. Admins are exempt from content filtering; test deletion with an ordinary account.
📖 签到积分 · 功能说明\n\n积分按群和成员独立保存，默认关闭；开启可签到，:
📖 Check-in points · Feature guide

Separate per group/member; default off. Enables check-in, transfers and shop redemption, without automatically rewarding chat.

Current base: {checkin_award} points. Consecutive day 2 adds 1, day 3 adds 2, up to 6 extra. Missed days reset the streak. Calendar days follow bot timezone, not 24 hours since last check-in; same-day repeats add nothing.

Admins can adjust up to 10000 at a time, never below zero. Reply to a group member with /transfer amount and confirm within 5 minutes; no deduction before confirmation.

Off preserves balances/orders; admins can still adjust/process. Does not list rewards/create raffles. Free raffles are independent of points; no cash withdrawal.
📖 积分商城 · 功能说明\n\n• 上架：设置名称、积分价、库存及人工领取说明:
📖 Points shop · Feature guide

• List name, price, stock and manual collection instructions; up to 30 active rewards/group, no automatic delivery.
• Redeem needs points enabled and sufficient balance/stock. Confirmation deducts points and 1 stock unit, creating a pending order. Stock 0 is sold out, not unlimited.
• Fulfill marks manual delivery, without charging again.
• Refund only pending orders, restoring original points and 1 stock unit once.
• Delist stops new purchases; existing orders still need processing.

Balance 100 at price 30 becomes 70 after confirmation; a pending refund restores 100. Viewing/previewing charges nothing; group /buy ID redeems immediately. Listing alone does not enable points. No cash payment/automatic shipping; back up the database for complete data.
📖 商城订单 · 功能说明\n\n• 待核销：成员已扣积分与库存，等待管理员人工:
📖 Shop orders · Feature guide

Pending means points/stock deducted and awaiting manual delivery. Fulfill marks delivery without automatic delivery/another charge. Refund applies only to pending orders, restoring points and one stock unit.

Admins see the latest 40 pending orders. Check the order, member and reward. Fulfilled/refunded orders cannot be processed twice; delisting does not cancel existing orders.

Existing orders can be processed with points off. Members see only their own latest 20 and cannot perform admin processing.
📖 免费抽奖 · 功能说明\n\n• 创建：开放本群报名，每群同一时间仅一个开放:
📖 Free raffles · Feature guide

• Create opens entries; one open raffle per group, without entering everyone.
• Enter gives current verified members one free entry; repeats do not add chances.
• Draw after admin confirmation selects one eligible random winner, saves the result and attempts an announcement.
• Cancel ends without a winner. History reads results without drawing again.

Independent of points/shop; no timed automatic draw or automatic prize delivery. Eligibility rechecked before drawing; empty raffles cannot draw. Announcement failure does not discard the result; check history before retrying.
📖 界面语言 · 功能说明\n\n目前支持简体中文和English，两类设置分别:

Supports Simplified Chinese and English, with separate saved choices:
• Personal changes your private admin pages, member service and buttons, not other people's interfaces.
• Group changes the selected group's system notices, verification and command replies; requires admin permission.

Personal English/group Chinese gives you English private buttons and Chinese group challenges. Custom welcomes, rules, announcements, replies, rewards, keywords and names keep their original language.

Does not change protection, points or timezone, recognize speech or translate chat. Saved across restarts; command names unchanged. Server gg menus and online docs remain Chinese.

Lists implemented commands; reading does not run them. Most administration also has private group selection/buttons.

Members use /menu; admins use /panel or private /start. Settings, balances, orders and activities are separate per group.

Management requires numeric IDs and permissions. Some commands act immediately, including /buy deducting points. Use buttons for preview/confirmation. Each Feature guide explains purpose, conditions and switches; online docs provide complete steps.

• Check in claims points once per calendar day when enabled.
• Points/rankings show this group's balance/points, not chat activity.
• Shop previews then confirms redemption with points enabled and sufficient balance/stock.
• Orders shows your latest 20 records.
• Raffle views first, then separately enters for free; independent of points.
• Rules/My ID reads group rules and numeric IDs.

Every click checks membership/verification. Groups have separate balances/orders/entries. Does not enable points, list rewards or create raffles for admins. To transfer, reply in the group with /transfer amount, then confirm personally.

📖 My check-in and points · Feature guide

When admins enable points, check in once per calendar day. Current base: {checkin_award}; consecutive days add up to 6 extra. Repeats add nothing; missed days reset the streak.

Points/rankings belong to this group, without chat rewards. Off preserves balances/private queries. Use for listed virtual rewards, without cash withdrawal.

Transfer by replying in the group with /transfer amount, up to 1000. Only the sender can confirm within 5 minutes; no deduction beforehand. Not to yourself, bots or people in other groups.

Reading does not check in, transfer or spend points. Back only queries balance.

📖 Member shop and orders · Feature guide

Select a reward to preview price, instructions and deduction. Confirmation deducts points/stock and creates a pending order. Preview lasts 5 minutes; expiry or stock changes need a fresh one.

Balance 100 at price 30 becomes 70 on confirmation. Wait for manual delivery; fulfillment charges nothing more. Admin refund of a pending order restores original points; fulfilled orders cannot be refunded again.

Stock 0 is sold out. Disabled points, insufficient balance or delisted rewards prevent redemption. Your latest 20 orders only; no automatic shipping. Group /buy ID redeems immediately; use buttons for confirmation.

Reading does not purchase/spend points. Return to shop and select a reward again.

View first, then click Enter for free to participate. Repeats give one chance; no points charged and points need not be enabled.

Requires verified group membership. Leaving removes open entries; eligibility rechecked at draw. Admins manually draw one random winner and deliver prizes; no automatic timed draw/delivery.

If no activity is open, ask admins to create one. Reading or returning only views, without entering. Viewing is not participation.

Reads this group's saved rules, also available via /rules. Welcome off does not disable rules queries.

Text for members is not automatically converted into keyword/link/penalty conditions. Admins configure protection separately.

Custom rules stay in their original language. Groups have separate rules; contact admins for changes.

Read-only; does not change identity, name, points or permissions. Private /id shows your own ID; admins can reply to a member in the group with /id to identify them.
